svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-08-07
svg.desc: NavMesh tooling, Role Battle planning, and Day 1 runtime smoke fixes.
svg.text: 2026-08-07 - Navigation fallback and Role/Battle Day 1
main | commits a26d241, f711913, 098d7be | manually reconstructed daily mind map
Daily job
Make AI navigation recoverable, define the 20-day delivery program, and prove the Day 1 baseline.
Editor tooling, plan documents, player lifecycle code, tests, and a bounded runtime runner changed together.
BEFORE
Silent baseline failures
No NavMesh could make moves fail
without a useful recovery path.
No staged Role/Battle execution index.
Persistent ASC defaults could accumulate
across replacement pawn respawns.
add tools and gates
AFTER
Recoverable navigation and executable Day 1
Editor menu and Python script compute bounds, add NavMeshBoundsVolume, save, and build paths.
BehaviorU checks for NavMesh and falls back to direct movement when absent.
20-day Role/Battle index and day plans define scope, dependencies, and release gates.
Day 1 runner validates assets, damage in both directions, and two stable respawns.
Guard: default attributes apply once to persistent ASC; SetByCaller values receive zero defaults.
Important guard
A missing NavMesh is a known runtime condition, not
an unexplained AI failure. Respawn initialization must
not reapply persistent default attribute effects.
The headless gate remains separate from visual/editor presentation.
Validation and reading path
Recorded: editor build, native Aura automation,
AuraAbilityGraph smoke 22/22, StartupMap load,
both damage directions, and two stable respawns.
Read Role-Battle-Baseline-2026-08-07.md for the full gate.
